ideas.text: Refuse to render any CAD file until that Matter has a numeral ledger holding at least the spec-side of the 37 CFR 1.84 bijection.
ideas.rationale: The surest way to keep CAD decorative is a three.js window that opens with no Fig. N and no numeral 24. Invert it: the existing render driver is locked until the knowledge graph has a Matter-local numeral table agents can already query over MCP.

ideas.text: Harvest AutoCAD block names, layers, and xrefs from the 837-file DWG corpus as candidate Claim and PatentAsset parts.
ideas.rationale: CAD is unlinkable when treated as tessellation. The live corpus already names parts in DWG structure at 4:1 over STEP; promoting those strings onto the graph is the link, not a prettier solid.

ideas.text: Rebuild a ghost text layer from callout positions in this month’s .ai, .svg, and outline-only illustrator PDFs.
ideas.rationale: The dangerous delivery is art with no text, so ClaimMaster-class checks are theater and the numeral graph stays hostage. Negation is restoring hidden, auditable numerals on the files Tom actually edited this month, then hanging them on the KG.

ideas.text: On every DWG or STEP content-hash change, mark Fig/numeral/claim edges that pointed at the old hash as epistemically stale.
ideas.rationale: The corpus is still being saved into 2026. The way CAD becomes a lie is an attachment that never updates. The bitemporal edge layer already exists; CAD hashes become valid-time bounds instead of dead filenames.

ideas.text: Put client invention solids and PriorArtReference solids in separate numeral namespaces and separate MCP tool contexts.
ideas.rationale: One scene, one “10,” two owners is how CAD becomes inequitable-conduct fuel. Invert it: an agent cannot see both geometries in one call unless it writes an explicit comparison edge.

ideas.text: Emit an illustrator job packet—named views, numeral map, lead-line do-not-cross rules—and leave the human inker.
ideas.rationale: A system that tries to replace the $170 sheet set makes CAD expensive and unused. The opposite of “agent draws” is “agent specifies”; CAD only supplies the views the packet names.

ideas.text: Queue every spec numeral with no picked DWG entity, STEP face, or SVG group as an unwitnessed defect.
ideas.rationale: Prose-only numerals are how drawings stay legally unlinked. The link is a geometric witness edge; missing witnesses are first-class graph facts a local agent can close by pointing, never by inventing solids.
